claude.sample_unit: AI-generated visceral aneurysm clinical scenarios and responses

links.outcome: Agreement between LLM self-assessment and human evaluator grading of correctness
links.effect: LLM self-assessed 89% of responses as correct (scores 1-2) versus 67% by human evaluators (P < 0.0001), with the greatest discrepancy in the partially correct category.
links.quote: ChatGPT-4o-mini self-assessed 89% of responses as correct (scores 1-2), compared to 67% by human evaluators (chi-square, P < 0.0001), with the greatest discrepancy in the partially correct category.

links.outcome: Accuracy of LLM clinical responses against expert human evaluation
links.effect: Human evaluators rated 67% of responses correct; AI self-assessment overestimated correctness (89%).
links.quote: However, the 67% correctness rate and systematic AI self-overestimation indicate that current LLMs remain unsuitable for independent clinical use, reinforcing the need for expert oversight.
